responsibility: First-launch onboarding flow: welcome, PIPL privacy consent summary with equally prominent agree/decline, language selection, optional user-initiated photo-library connection with iCloud download guidance, and first local-model load progress. Notification, location and HealthKit authorization are excluded from the launch sequence and are requested only after an explicit opt-in on the related Awakening surface.

inputs.privacySummary: PIPL privacy policy summary with purpose/method/kind/retention/local-processing statement (US-PRV-008 AC-2)
inputs.permissionSteps: After PIPL consent, offer a skippable photo-library connection choice. Request PhotoKit only after the user explicitly chooses Connect Photos. Notification, location and HealthKit remain contextual Awakening opt-ins and never appear as a launch-time permission chain.
inputs.icloudDownloadPrompt: US-SRC-001 AC-6 first photo permission download-and-keep-original hint with Open Settings button
inputs.languages: zh-Hans | en-US picker (US-SYN-001 AC-2); traditional/other mapped to zh-Hans with one-time hint
inputs.modelLoadProgress: Determinate progress for first model load (§15.6); driven by ModelLoaderActor.overallStatus (3F.3), no fixture fallback in production

outputs.visibleContent: Guided full-screen flow: welcome -> privacy consent -> language -> optional Connect Photos choice -> model loading. Decline exits; skipping photos continues without a system permission request.
outputs.interactionTargets: onboarding-start, onboarding-privacy-agree, onboarding-privacy-decline, onboarding-permission-allow, onboarding-permission-deny, onboarding-permission-skip, onboarding-open-settings, onboarding-language-zh, onboarding-language-en, onboarding-begin-load, onboarding-declined-close
outputs.accessibilityTree: Step indicator announced; privacy summary scrollable; agree/decline visible at the same hierarchy with neither preselected; optional photo connection and skip are explicit; language picker has a selected checkmark

systemContainer: fullScreenCover + TabView (step pages) + Form (language picker) + ProgressView (model loading)
fallbackConditions: FullScreenCover so system back is disabled; explicit Continue/Decline navigation only
Optional permissions never block entry and are not automatically requested again after denial or skip
